DockQ Rust is a standalone Rust CLI for scoring protein, nucleic-acid, peptide,
and small-molecule docking models.

Each platform archive includes the executable, build metadata, project and
third-party license notices, and SHA-256 checksums. Verify the checksums before
using a downloaded archive.

This release is maintained in enriquead1/DockQ and is independent of releases
from the original DockQ project. See rust/README.md for usage and
rust/MIGRATION_STATUS.md for compatibility boundaries and known differences.
